headline: Former State Leader Rejects Calls To Boycott Elections, Opting Instead To Attend Every Booth Simply To Argue With The Voter Ink
body: The senior politician announced he will attend the upcoming polls exclusively to engage in a formal, high-decibel debate with the indelible ink technician regarding its long-term smudge resistance. He plans to register his protest by meticulously cross-examining the polling officer's stapling technique on every ballot paper.
caption: Not even a full-blown election boycott can stop this man from showing up to argue about office supplies. Would you go this far to make your point? #Elections2024 #Politics #Satire (satire)
igHook: Tag someone who would actually audit the stapling technique at their local polling booth.
